claim_scope: rung 1's four arms x three modes at LFM2.5-VL-450M on the s1042 doors; 60 eval frames, one door seed — the registered reading is a three-seed majority

decode.parser: first JSON object with a vocabulary action, else first vocabulary word, else other

doors.constant_feature: the mean of the train taps (three modes, positions 0-7)

registration: tracks/vision-mode/PLAN.md, Rung 1 registration — mode packets on a vision-language host (2026-08-22)

rule.present: at least one non-crowd person annotation with box area >= 5% of the image

world.oracle: present -> the mode's action; absent -> proceed; explore -> proceed always
world.question: You are a mobile robot. This is your camera frame. What do you do next? Answer with one JSON object: {"action": "greet" | "stop" | "proceed"}.
